Wrote [benchmark/protocol.md](../benchmark/protocol.md), an unpinned, unreviewed method draft saved after each section.
All six required sections are present; the document is 114 lines, within the approximate 250-line limit.
Tasks cover inventoried families and visible gaps, with gradeable claims and citations into preserved originals.
The method separates reading fidelity, answer correctness and source grounding using independently established evidence.
It specifies project/family holdouts, variant detection, tested isolation, matched baselines and discriminating challenges.
The resource table records missing capabilities, least access, providers, publication limits, revocation and readiness checks.
No preparation index, milestone status, evaluator policy or other project file was changed.

Verification: the section/line-count check and `python3 policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check` both exited 0.
The evaluator reports no errors and still lists tasks, oracle, split, baseline and challenges as missing, as expected for an unpinned draft.
Benchmark readiness remains false; no native jobs, model comparisons or scoring challenges were executed.
No quality thresholds were introduced.

## What next

The Policymaker should order an independent method review, then use the resource table to prepare concrete owner requests and public development work.
Resume from the saved draft; avoid repeating the inventory reads or treating structural verification as substantive benchmark acceptance.

Waiting for the owner: request #143.
